card.name: Reporting verbs after was/were in findings
card.fires_on: The word right after 'was' or 'were' that reports a trial result, such as found, observed or predominantly. It appears in adverse-event and safety-finding sentences with percentages.

modes.label: found after were
modes.description: 'were found to have' introduces a lab or ECG finding in a share of patients.
modes.example: MDS, treated with TIBSOVO monotherapy in the clinical trial (AG120-C-001), 9% were<< found>> to have a QTc interval greater than

modes.label: observed after was/were
modes.description: 'was observed' or 'were observed' reports a higher rate or event in a treated group.
modes.example: with adverse safety findings of higher mortality in the high hematocrit target group. Higher mortality (35% vs. 29%) was<< observed>> for the patients randomized to a target hem

modes.label: predominantly after were
modes.description: An adverb after 'were' describes how infections were graded.
